body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Move up to 2 units, ignoring the first difficult space. Reduce your next incoming forced movement by 2 units until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Gain +1 Composure against hostile influence until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Trance
rider.html: Enter Weightless Trance until the end of your next turn: if you accepted Strain on this card, you may stand from Prone on your turn without burning a die; otherwise your next leap may cross a 1-unit gap.
